test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The population of a certain village increases by 5 per cent annually. Its present population is 8200. After two year the population will be (approximately):
solution:
**Given :**

Population increasing with the rate r = 5%

Current Population P₀ = 8200

Time t = 2 years

**Formula Used :**

P = P₀ (1 + r/100)t

**Calculation :**

Population after 2 years P = 8200 (1 + 5/100)²

⇒ P = 8200 × (21 times 21)/(20 times 20)

⇒ P = 9040.5 = 9040 (approx)

**∴ The population of the village after 2 years = 9040 (approx).**
